name: Marin-Walk-Jump-Spaced
prompt: Create a NEW production sprite sheet, not an edit of an existing sheet. Rune Rumble Arcade Aura and Ink & Motion, deliberate detailed pixel art with dark outlines, navy, cyan, teal, ivory, coral and amber accents. No runes, shards, wood ornaments, glossy rendering, blur or text. First reference is MARIN identity: medium-brown skin, large dark navy hair/head, teal headband and tails, sea-green eyes, navy sleeveless coat with ivory lapels, turquoise sash, dark trousers, brown belt and boots, fingerless gloves and modest water gauntlets. Second reference FERN is only for matching big-head pixel-fighter proportions. Preserve Marin identity exactly, a broad head, broad shoulders, strong short torso, substantial boots, tall confident stance. Do NOT miniaturize the head or make him a squat dwarf. Square 2048x2048 transparent sheet. EXACTLY TWENTY complete isolated bodies, precisely FIVE equal columns and FOUR equal rows, one character per cell. First ten: a smooth in-place right-facing walk cycle. Last ten: crouch, takeoff, rise, apex, descent and landing. First action rows1-2, second rows3-4, five poses per row, reading order. CRITICAL PACKING: every entire sprite including hair, boots, fist, cloth and water must fit within the central 60 PERCENT of its cell, leaving at least 20 PERCENT of the cell EMPTY on all four sides. Each row has the exact same baseline and each column the exact same center. Keep LARGE TRANSPARENT ROW GAPS AND COLUMN GAPS. No pixel from any body may approach a neighbor, grid line or canvas edge. Treat all 20 cells as equally padded separate images. Arms/feet readable; compact water effects confined to hands, not giant overlapping waves. Same head and body scale across all poses, actual articulated animation drawings. No background, ground, shadow, captions, row labels, cell guides, frame lines or extra figures.
